claim: T-V3-39 (c) runs before its provider lands. The clause covers restoration: 'a restoration from level 1 to 0 removes the damage in reverse threshold order …; a restoration with no Works removes it at once, every patch drawn; a roof bay the roofless state opened is patched once the wing is roofed; an element a restoring re-cut or a later `extend` adds is drawn as built … (V06 §3.23 (3))'. It runs on the damage fixtures' 'one restored with patches' (V03 l. 2849). Its timing cell (V03 l. 2906) runs every clause 'from P4', apart from (e)'s and (h)'s exports and the scrub, saying only 'before M6-E the levels at V11's default age'. V03 §8's P4 cell (l. 2943) runs 'T-V3-39 but (e) and (h)'s exports'. Restoration and the per-element peak come from V06 §3.23 (3), which V06's E2 builds (V06 §8 l. 4230: 'the decay level (item 123 (b), V06 §3.23: `decayLevel`, `decayPeak`, restoration …)'). Until E2 lands, V02's X36 (l. 4198) is the stand-in, reading 'the level from the existence state at V11's default age, nothing repaired'. §13.8's T123 row (l. 19491) likewise lands 'T123-4's epoch clause with M6-E'. Round 6 scheduled V02's twin clauses (T-V2-59's restoration in reverse threshold order, its patches and the manor's `extend`) 'at the later of M6b and V06's E2 … since until E2 lands V02 reads X36's stand-in — nothing repaired' (V02 §8.6 l. 3897–3904; R6-09). V03 reads the same V06 functions (V03 l. 196–197), but its clause stays at P4. M6-P's rest and M6-E run on separate tracks (INDEX l. 81–85, 103–105), so P4 may exit before E2, and at that point (c) cannot pass: a restored building reads level 0 and draws no patch. This is R6-09's class (VV12-r5-02, VV34-r5-01). Nothing built changes.

claim: repair-r6-V02's hand-off (assemble-r6 §2.1: 'for the adjudicator to route') was routed by no adjudication. T-V3-40 (b) (V03 l. 2907) asserts each building of a returned district draws its look 'exactly in the condition's weeks, and at its own level outside them, after the hand-over (`crisisLookYields`)', and that 'a `disaster` preview draws its ruin over a building under a rebuild Works (a preview never hands over)'. Its timing cell runs (b) 'from P4 once item 122's base parts (M3b) and V01's districts (M5) stand', and V03 §8's P4 cell defers only (b)'s village clause. `crisisLookYields` is built by V06's E2 (V06 §8's E2 row: 'the crisis hand-over (item 122 (a), V06 §3.22 …)'); until then V02 reads X36's stand-in, 'nothing repaired, the look standing until its condition no longer stands' (V02 §8.6). R6-09 scheduled V02's twin clause, T-V2-60's hand-over, at the later of M6b and E2, but not V03's. Graded minor (R6-09's class): nothing built changes; the clause runs before its provider.
